title: Engine Shipping Container for the General Electric F-404-103 Engine
description: 1.0 DISCLAIMER This Sources Sought Synopsis/Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information and planning purposes�it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This RFI does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, the Government is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Respondents are advised that the Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI; all costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the interested party's expense. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future RFP, if any is issued. 2.0 INTRODUCTION & BACKGROUND The T-7 Systems Program Office (SPO) is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of manufacturing and providing peculiar packaging, specifically an engine shipping container (part number 21C11300G03), for the General Electric F-404-103 engine. The F-404-103 engine requires specialized, peculiar packaging to ensure its safe handling, transportation, and long-term storage without degradation or damage to the asset. The purpose of this notice is to gauge industry capabilities and identify qualified contractors, including small businesses, capable of meeting the requirements outlined below. 3.0 REQUIREMENT OVERVIEW The Government requires a highly durable, specialized shipping and storage container designed exclusively for the GE F-404-103 engine. The container must meet the following general characteristics and capabilities: Protection: Provide environmental and shock/vibration protection for the F-404-103 engine during intermodal transportation (air, land, and sea) and long-term storage. Compliance: Meet all applicable Military Standards (MIL-STD) for peculiar packaging, preservation, and shipping containers (MIL-STD-2073-1, MIL-STD-648). Design Characteristics: Provide secure engine mounting points, proper weight distribution, lifting and tie-down provisions, and environmental sealing (e.g., desiccant ports, humidity indicators). Durability: Constructed of materials capable of withstanding rough handling and extreme environmental conditions. Part Number: Must be the exact same as part number 21C11300G03 engine shipping container. 4.0 REQUESTED INFORMATION Interested parties are requested to submit a Capabilities Statement demonstrating their ability to fulfill this requirement. The submission should be formatted as a white paper (not to exceed 5 pages) and must include the following information: A. Company Profile Company Name and Address Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone Number, and Email Address) CAGE Code and Unique Entity ID (UEI) Business Size and Socioeconomic Status (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB) under the anticipated NAICS code. B. Capability & Experience A brief summary of the company's capabilities to manufacture peculiar packaging and specialized engine shipping containers. Examples of prior experience in designing, manufacturing, or overhauling specialized shipping containers of similar size, complexity, and weight (specifically for the F-404-103 engine). Include contract numbers, agency/customer names, and brief descriptions of the work performed. Provide a statement regarding the facility clearance level, if applicable. Provide information on manufacturing capacity and estimated lead times for production. C. Technical Feedback Any questions, comments, or concerns regarding the feasibility of the requirement. Identification of any potential supply chain issues or long-lead items. 5.0 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS All responses must be submitted electronically via email to the Point(s) of Contact listed below. Submissions must be received no later than 14 days from announcement, 1700 EDT on 25 September 2026. Respondents should indicate which portions of their responses are proprietary and mark accordingly, and all proprietary information must be clearly marked on the outside container and on the materials inside. The Government will handle all information properly marked as proprietary information. The Government is not liable for, or suffer any consequential damages, for any proprietary information not properly identified. Please include "Sources Sought Response: F-404-103 Engine Shipping Container - [Company Name]" in the email subject line. Proprietary information, if any, should be minimized and MUST BE CLEARLY MARKED. To aid the Government, please segregate proprietary information. 6.0 POINTS OF CONTACT Primary Point of Contact: Noah Ogle, Contract Specialist Email: noah.ogle@us.af.mil Phone: 385-680-0471 Secondary Point of Contact: Diana M. Whilding, Contracting Officer Email: diana.whilding@us.af.mil Phone: 385-636-2264

title: F/A-18E/F and EA-18G Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) for Zn/Ni Conformal Anodes
description: The F/A-18E/F and EA-18G Program Office (PMA-265) intends to issue a firm fixed price competitive solicitation for non-recurring engineering (NRE) for F/A-18E/F and EA-18G Nose Landing Gear (NLG) and Main Landing Gear (MLG) Conformal Anodes to facilitate the transition from legacy Cadmium (CAD) plating to Low Hydrogen Embrittlement (LHE) Zinc/Nickel (Zn/Ni) plating. Under this effort, the Contractor will design, develop, fabricate, and deliver conformal anodes, associated technical drawings, and anode cases for Zn/Ni plating for the specified landing gear components. The Contractor will be responsible for performing first article inspection (FAI) in conjunction with the existing landing gear overhaul line and confirm, through current density analysis reports, adequate thickness and uniformity of Zn/Ni plating. In addition, the Contractor will also be required to provide the necessary updates to the Technical Data Package to support the transition to Zn/Ni. title: Denmark – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Udbud med forhandling af kontrakt om levering, implementering, drift, vedligeholdelse og support af økonomi- og lønsystem til Gribskov Kommune
description: Nærværende udbud vedrører indgåelse af kontrakt om Ordregivers anskaffelse af et integreret økonomi- og lønsystem med særligt fokus på sikker, stabil og effektiv drift. Kontrakten omfatter levering og implementering af løsningen samt den efterfølgende drift, vedligeholdelse og support. Under økonomidelen ligger såvel debitor, opkrævning mv., og under løndelen hører også vagtplan. Driftsydelsen udgør et centralt element i kontrakten, og omfatter det fulde ansvar for løsningens daglige drift, herunder sikring af høj tilgængelighed, performance og driftsstabilitet. Formålet med udbuddet er at etablere en fremtidssikret og robust platform, der understøtter Ordregivers økonomi- og lønadministration effektivt og med høj grad af automatisering, kvalitet og driftssikkerhed, herunder tidssvarende teknologiske muligheder i form af understøttelse af maskinlæring og kunstig intelligens samt andre værktøjer, der kan bidrage til øget automatisering og beslutningsstøtte.

title: Denmark – Construction work – FAB afd. 12, Mosegårdsparken - Hovedentrepriseudbud
description: Disse udbudsbetingelser gælder for realisering af Fyns Almennyttige Boligselskab afd. 12, Mosegården med støtte fra Landsbyggefonden. Udbuddet gennemføres som et begrænset udbud med forudgående prækvalifikation efter udbudslovens § 58-60. Det er således kun de virksomheder, der bliver prækvalificeret af Ordregiver, der vil blive opfordret til at afgive tilbud. Denne opfordring til at afgive tilbud omfatter udelukkende det i disse udbudsbetingelser nævnte bygge- og anlægsarbejde. Fyns Almennyttige Boligselskab er et alment boligselskab underlagt det lovgrundlag og regelsæt, der gælder for almene boligorganisationer. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at samtlige projektdokumenter, som fremgår af den fælles dokumentfortegnelse, er en del af udbudsmaterialet. Tilbudsgiver er pligtig til at kontrollere at denne har adgang til det fulde projektmateriale. Tilbudsgiver opfordres til at læse det samlede udbudsmateriale grundigt igennem, da det indeholder de nødvendige informationer for tilbudsafgivelse. Udbudsmaterialet består endvidere af spørgsmål og svar samt eventuelle rettelsesblade, som løbende bliver offentliggjort på udbudsportalen i anonymiseret form. Det udbudte omfatter bygge- og anlægsarbejder i hovedentreprise vedrørende renovering af helhedsplaner for Afd. 12 - Mosegårdsparken Primulavej 1-73, Lathyrusvej 1-89, Monbergsvej 51-59 5000 Odense C. Ordregiver forventer, at kontrakten vil blive indgået i henhold til tidsplanen. Begrundelsen for varigheden af perioden mellem tildelingsbeslutningen og kontraktindgåelsen er ansøgningsprocessen for ydelsesstøtte til renoveringsprojekter, der tildeles af Landsbyggefonden. I perioden mellem tildelingsbeslutning og kontraktindgåelse ansøger Ordregiver herom. Den vindende tilbudsgiver er forpligtet til at bistå Ordregiver med eventuelle oplysninger, såfremt Ordregiver anmoder herom. Der indgås kontrakt med én hovedentreprenør. Som en del af projektmaterialet indgår grundlag for entreprisekontrakt. Det er udelukkende hovedentreprenøren der skal leve op til mindstekravene. Udelukkelsesgrunde: Ordregiver vil udelukke ansøgere der er omfattet af: • De obligatoriske udelukkelsesgrunde i udbudslovens §§ 135, stk. 1-3 og 136. • De frivillige udelukkelsesgrunde i udbudslovens § 137, stk. 1, nr. 1-6. Såfremt en ansøger er omfattet af de obligatoriske eller frivillige udelukkelses-grunde i udbudslovens §§ 135-136 samt 137, stk. 1, nr. 1-6, kan ansøger ved at fremlægge tilstrækkelig dokumentation for sin pålidelighed påvise, at denne alligevel ikke skal udelukkes, jf. betingelserne i udbudslovens § 138. Ordregiver vil i tilfælde af, at den påtænker at udelukke en ansøger, fastsætte en passende frist for fremlæggelse af tilstrækkelig dokumentation for ansøgerens pålidelighed. Rådets forordning (EU) 2022/576 Der kan ikke tildeles kontrakt til følgende virksomheder, jf. Rådets forordning (EU) 2022/576 af 8. April 2022 om ændring af forordning (EU) nr. 833/2014 om restriktive foranstaltninger på baggrund af Ruslands handlinger, der destabiliserer situationen i Ukraine: A. russiske statsborgere eller fysiske eller juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, der er etableret i Rusland B. juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, hvoraf en enhed som omhandlet i nærværende stykkes litra a) direkte eller indirekte ejer over 50 %, eller C. fysiske eller juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, der handler på vegne af eller efter anvisning fra en enhed som omhandlet i nærværende stykkes litra a) eller b), Ligeledes kan der ikke anvendes underleverandører eller støttende enheder, der er omfattet af ovenstående, hvis denne aktørs bidrag udgør mere end 10 % af kontraktværdien. Ordregiver har til hensigt at prækvalificere 5 ansøgere, som vil blive opfordret til at afgive tilbud. Hvis flere end 5 ansøgere opfylder Ordregivers krav til egnethed, udvælger Ordre-giver de 5 ansøgere, der samlet set har dokumenteret den mest relevante og sammenlignelige erfaring i forhold til den udbudte opgave. Ved udvælgelsen lægges der vægt på følgende: • Referencernes relevans i forhold til nærværende projekt, herunder renoveringsomfang, opgavetype og kompleksitet. • Erfaring med hovedentrepriser af sammenlignelig størrelse og kompleksitet. • Erfaring med renoveringsopgaver for almene boligorganisationer. • Erfaring med genhusning, beboerkontakt og arbejder i beboede boliger. • Ansøgers konkrete rolle og ansvar i referenceprojektet. • Referencernes økonomiske størrelse. Referencer med en entreprisesum på minimum 100 mio. kr. ekskl. moms tillægges positiv vægt. Referencer med en entreprisesum på minimum 150 mio. kr. ekskl. moms tillægges særlig positiv vægt. Ved udvælgelsen foretager Ordregiver en samlet vurdering af de afleverede referencers relevans og sammenlignelighed.

title: Italy – Drinks dispensers – Noleggio full service di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali della Rai di Roma, Milano e Sedi Regionali
description: La presente procedura è finalizzata all’affidamento di un Contratto avente ad oggetto il noleggio “full service”, articolato in n. 2 lotti, di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali della Rai di Roma, Milano e Sedi Regionali. Ai sensi dell’art. 58 del Codice, la procedura è articolata nei seguenti n. 2 lotti, il cui perimetro è stato definito sulla base di distinti criteri infra dettagliati: Noleggio “full service” di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali Rai di Roma e Milano Noleggio “full service” di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali Rai delle Sedi Regionali. Tenuto conto dei principi in materia, il perimetro di ciascun lotto è stato definito applicando un criterio geografico per un bilanciamento tra obiettivi diversi: mantenere una logica di continuità territoriale per la preminente esigenza connessa ad un efficiente gestione della prestazione contrattuale e, al contempo, consentire la partecipazione alle microimprese, piccole e medie imprese (MPMI) in grado di modulare la propria offerta in relazione a potenziali specificità territoriali. In riferimento al Lotto n. 2 delle Sedi Regionali, si è ritenuto di non suddividere ulteriormente i diversi cespiti al fine di conseguire il raggiungimento di elevate economie di scala generate dall’aggregazione della domanda. Il Servizio dovrà svolgersi in esecuzione delle prescrizioni contenute nel Capitolato tecnico nonché di tutti gli ulteriori documenti di gara, tenendo conto, inoltre, di quanto previsto dalla normativa vigente in materia in conformità al Cap. 5 dei Criteri Ambientali Minimi (“CAM”) relativi ai servizi di ristoro e alla distribuzione di acqua di rete a fini potabili, di cui al decreto 6 novembre 2023, adottati con Decreto del Ministero dell’ambiente e della sicurezza energetica del 9 aprile 2025, pubblicati sulla Gazzetta Ufficiale serie generale n. 96 del 26/04/2025. In particolare, l'oggetto dell'appalto consiste nel noleggio full service di erogatori di acqua potabile presso le sedi Rai interessate dall'iniziativa, come infra specificate, secondo le quantità indicate nella Parte 3a Elenco delle apparecchiature del Capitolato Tecnico. Il noleggio comprende, oltre alla messa a disposizione delle apparecchiature, le seguenti attività accessorie e strumentali, il cui valore economico complessivamente considerato è stimato in misura inferiore al 12% dell'importo posto a base di gara per ciascun lotto: a) installazione degli erogatori, comprensiva dei collegamenti elettrici e idrici (adduzione e scarico) ai punti predisposti dalla Rai da completarsi entro 15 giorni lavorativi dall’avvio del Contratto; b) manutenzione completa ordinaria e correttiva delle apparecchiature, comprensiva delle verifiche, controlli e revisioni periodiche (cfr. “Parte 2° Programma di manutenzione periodica” del Capitolato Tecnico), delle attività di sanificazione, della sostituzione dei materiali di consumo e delle parti soggette ad usura, nonché di ogni ulteriore intervento necessario ad assicurarne il corretto funzionamento in conformità a quanto previsto anche dai documenti di manutenzione rilasciati dal costruttore degli erogatori, da eseguirsi in ottemperanza alle vigenti normative; c) esecuzione delle analisi periodiche delle acque previste dal Capitolato Tecnico; d) garanzia, assistenza tecnica, movimentazione delle apparecchiature e sostituzione integrale degli erogatori nei casi previsti dal Capitolato Tecnico ed, in particolare, per eventuali spostamenti degli erogatori in altri punti dello stesso cespite e/o di altri cespiti su espressa richiesta della Rai; e) interventi di miglioramento, adeguamento o sostituzione degli erogatori che risultino necessari per dare attuazione a modifiche normative o a specifiche richieste da parte delle autorità competenti; f) disinstallazione, spostamento, rimozione e ritiro degli erogatori al termine del contratto (o nel corso di svolgimento del Servizio quando necessario come da Capitolato) e contestuale ripristino degli spazi in status quo ante. Tali attività sono remunerate unitariamente mediante il canone contrattuale e non costituiscono autonome prestazioni principali. La fornitura si intende comprensiva delle certificazioni previste dal Capitolato e della documentazione tecnica attestante con chiarezza le modalità di utilizzazione, le specifiche tecniche, le modalità di installazione e le istruzioni di manutenzione nonché la conformità alla normativa europea vigente. Ogni prodotto deve essere corredato, ove presente, dalle relative istruzioni in lingua italiana per consentire un uso corretto ed in condizioni di sicurezza dello stesso e dalla garanzia del produttore. L’Appaltatore è, pertanto, tenuto, a propria cura e spese, e con propria organizzazione ed attrezzatura, a porre in atto tutti gli interventi e le verifiche che le leggi impongono, i controlli, e quant’altro necessario, anche se non esplicitamente specificato, per il mantenimento in perfetta efficienza degli erogatori di acqua potabile oggetto dell’Appalto, assumendosene tutti gli oneri e le responsabilità secondo i termini e le condizioni previsti dal Capitolato Tecnico. Non sono previsti limiti di partecipazione ai lotti e/o di aggiudicazione dei lotti nei confronti del medesimo operatore economico.

title: Denmark – Construction work – GENERISK IV SAMT DOMICILER – TAULOV DRY PORT A/S
description: Ved nærværende udbud ønsker Ordregiver at indhente tilbud på projektering og udførelse af ”Generisk VI samt domiciler”, der er et lager- og logistikcenter som Taulov Dryport A/S opfører i området ved Hertugens Kvarter i Taulov. Her er det Ordregivers ønske at udvikle en dynamisk, kvalitetsstærk og fremtidsparat bebyggelse, der afspejler og understøtter udviklingen af Taulov Dryport som Danmarks førende knudepunkt for transport og logistik. Nærværende dokument indeholder betingelser og vejledning om afgivelse af ansøgning og tilbud på denne opgave. Ordregivers krav til kontraktvilkår fremgår af udbudsmaterialets udkast til totalentreprisekontrakt, mens kravene til ydelsen er detaljeret beskrevet i udbudsmaterialet, herunder byggeprogram inkl. bilag. Udbuddet gennemføres i overensstemmelse med Forsyningsvirksomhedsdirektivet, DIREKTIV 2014/25/EU af 26. februar 2014. Udbuddet omfatter en option, der vedrører indretning af mezzaniner. Udbuddet omfatter en option, der vedrører udførelse af 2 stk. kontorbygninger. Optionen er nærmere beskrevet i Udkast til kontrakt pkt. 1.03 og i byggeprogrammet bilag 2.02. Udbuddet gennemføres som et udbud med forhandling, og forløber i tre faser; en prækvalifikationsfase hvor egnede virksomheder udvælges til at deltage i udbuddet, en indledende tilbudsfase og en forhandlingsfase med efterfølgende afgivelse af endeligt tilbud. title: Netherlands – Road-maintenance works – Raamovereenkomst dagelijks en groot onderhoud elementenverhardingen en straatmeubilair 2027-2028
description: Aanbestedende dienst heeft tot doel een aannemer te contracteren die zorg draagt voor vakkundig onderhoud van alle elementenverhardingen die in het beheer zijn van de gemeente Gouda. Daarnaast maakt het leveren van een aantal andere diensten, zoals het inrichten en in stand houden van een wachtdienst, het verzorgen van onderhoud aan straatmeubilair en het afwikkelen van meldingen onderdeel uit van het af te sluiten contract. Hierbij is het de insteek van de gemeente om zoveel mogelijk de werkzaamheden over te laten aan de Opdrachtnemer, waarbij een goede balans tussen het ontzorgen van en het houden van regie door de gemeente het streven is. De aan te besteden Opdracht bestaat uit het uitvoeren van dagelijks en groot onderhoud aan elementen- en halfverhardingen en straatmeubilair binnen de gemeente Gouda, waaronder in ieder geval: • Spoedherstel n.a.v. spoedmeldingen; • Planbaar herstel n.a.v. meldingen; • Grondwerk t.b.v. onderhoudswerkzaamheden; • Leidingwerk t.b.v. onderhoudswerkzaamheden; • Dagelijks onderhoud elementen- en halfverhardingen (< 200 m2 per tracé/wegvak); • Groot onderhoud elementen- en halfverhardingen (> 200 m2 per tracé/wegvak); • Kleine aanpassingen, veranderingen en reconstructies openbare ruimte; • Herstel en incidentele vervanging van straatmeubilair en wegbebakening; • Opstellen verkeersmaatregelenplannen t.b.v. uitvoeringswerkzaamheden; • Toepassen maatregelen t.b.v. waarborgen bereikbaarheid. Daarnaast maakt het verzorgen van een wachtdienst, het afwikkelen van meldingen en het verzorgen van de benodigde vergunningen voor eigen werk onderdeel uit van de Opdracht. Het te onderhouden areaal verhardingen bedraagt circa 1,8 miljoen m2 elementenverhardingen en circa 52.000 m2 halfverharde wegen.

title: Germany – Engineering services – MPI für Geoanthropologie, Jena - Umbau und Generalsanierung zum Institutsgebäude von zwei denkmalgeschützten Klinikgebäuden - Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung (Labor)
description: Der Leistungsumfang betrifft die umfangreiche Generalsanierung von zwei denkmalgeschützten Bestandsgebäuden (ehemalige Kliniken) mit Planung und Umbau zu neuen Verwaltungs- und Laborräumen für das Max-Planck-Institut für Geoanthropologie in Jena. Auf dem Flurstück 105 / Lessingstraße 1 befindet sich die ehemalige Urologie mit einem denkmalgeschützten Teil aus dem Jahr 1914 und einem Anbau aus dem Jahr 1991. Auf dem Flurstück 102/5 / Lessingstraße 2 befindet sich die ehemalige HNO aus dem Baujahr 1928. Die Gebäude sind jeweils 4-geschossig mit zusätzlichem teilbelichtetem Kellergeschoss sowie nicht ausgebautem Giebelgeschoss. Gebäude und Gartenanlage stehen unter Denkmalschutz; daher ist eine enge Abstimmung mit dem Landesamt für Denkmalpflege bzw. der unteren Denkmalschutzbehörde erforderlich. Das Institutsgebäude wird überwiegend aus Büroflächen und Büronebenflächen bestehen. Weiterhin sind Seminarräume, ein Laborbereich mit Lagerflächen, Serverräume und ein Decision Theatre vorgesehen. Der Laborbereich wird als gemeinsam genutzter Laborpool für alle experimentell arbeitenden Organisationseinheiten ausgebildet. Der hochinstallierte Experimentalbereich mit Laboren, Laborlagern und Servern soll im Anbau der ehemaligen Urologie untergebracht werden. Die niedrig installierten Büro- und Kommunikationsflächen werden im denkmalgeschützten Teil der Urologie sowie in der HNO untergebracht. Gegenstand dieses VgV-Vergabeverfahrens sind die Leistungen der Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung (Medizin- oder labortechnische Anlagen) gemäß § 55 HOAI in Verbindung mit Anlage 15 zur HOAI 2021 für die Anlagengruppe 7 in den Leistungsphasen 2, 3 und 5 bis 9 sowie die im Vertrag und in dessen Anlage A beschriebenen Besonderen Leistungen. Das Projekt wird als BIM-Projekt im Open-BIM-Verfahren durchgeführt. Bestandteil des Auftrags sind außerdem die in den Vertragsunterlagen einschließlich Leistungsbild beschriebenen BIM-bezogenen Leistungen, Koordinationsleistungen sowie die Erstellung, Fortschreibung und Bereitstellung der Fachmodelle nach den vertraglichen Vorgaben. Weitere Angaben zur Ausgangssituation, Aufgabenstellung und zum Leistungsumfang ergeben sich aus Anlage 01 sowie aus dem Ingenieurvertrag Labor einschließlich Leistungsbild. Besonderer Hinweis betr. title: Germany – Research and development consultancy services – 10030774-Providing Technical Assistance on Industrial Decarbonisation, CBAM Readiness, Gender Inclusion, Pilot and Upscaling
description: India's industrial sector plays a central role in the country's economic growth, while also contributing significantly to energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. As India advances its climate ambitions, including the target of achieving net-zero emissions by 2070, industrial decarbonisation and energy efficiency have become key priorities for enabling a sustainable and inclusive transition. In this context, the Indo-German bilateral cooperation between the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), implemented by GIZ, supports industrial decarbonisation through energy efficiency measures. Acting as a service provider and implementing agency for German international cooperation for sustainable development, GIZ works with Indian and German partners on project implementation and delivering effective solutions that contribute to sustainable transformation. The cooperation between the German side and BEE builds on a long-standing partnership in the field of energy efficiency and industrial transformation. Over the years, the collaboration has continuously supported the implementation of the Energy Conservation Act and contributed to a range of initiatives targeting both large industries and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). While significant progress has been achieved, considerable untapped potential for industrial energy efficiency and decarbonisation remains, underlining the need for strengthened policy frameworks, innovative market instruments, and scaled implementation approaches. Against this background, the project "Energy Efficiency" supports industrial decarbonisation through four key intervention areas: (a) developing strategies for industrial decarbonisation, including in the context of the Indian Carbon Market; (b) supporting the design and implementation of incentive schemes such as ADEETIE; (c) promoting industrial energy efficiency measures through demonstration projects and awareness campaigns; and (d) advancing gender equality and social inclusion in the industrial transition. Through these interventions, the project aims to strengthen policy frameworks, market mechanisms, institutional capacities, and inclusive approaches for a sustainable industrial transformation.

title: Radiation Testing
description: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC) has a requirement for engineering services and support to conduct ground-based accelerated radiation testing of microelectronic and photonic elements. NASA conducts evaluations of candidate electrical, electronic, and electromechanical (EEE) parts for use in spacecraft and spaceflight instruments. The specified analysis procedures sometimes require ground-based accelerated radiation testing, necessitating the use of particle accelerators to emulate the space environment. These ground-based tests use particle accelerators to provide ion beams that can be employed to evaluate single-event effects (SEE), total ionizing dose (TID), and displacement damage dose (DDD). Understanding these effects is critical for mission success. The period of performance is anticipated to be up to five (5) years from the date of award. NASA/GSFC intends to issue a sole source blanket purchase agreement (BPA) and calls placed against the BPA in accordance with FAR Part 12.201-1(e)(3) to acquire these services from the Cyclotron Institute at Texas A&M University (TAMU) under the statutory authority of 41 U.S.C. 1901, Simplified acquisition procedures. TAMU is the only known facility that can provide the necessary tuned beam energies of 15, 25, and 40 MeV/u, uniform particle fluxes up to 1e5/(cm2.s), an in-air testing/positioning system, and the required ease of access. The Government intends to acquire a commercial product or service using FAR Part 12. Interested organizations may submit their capabilities and qualifications to perform the effort electronically via email to Stephanie Stephens at stephanie.d.stephens@nasa.gov and Jason Lou at jason.d.lou@nasa.gov not later than 6:00pm EST on September 25, 2026. Such capabilities/qualifications will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct this acquisition on a competitive basis. A decision by the Government not to compete this acquisition on a full and open competition basis, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government. NASA Clause 1852.215-84, Ombudsman, is applicable. The Center Ombudsman for this acquisition can be found at: https://www.hq.nasa.gov/office/procurement/regs/Procurement-Ombuds-Comp-Advocate-Listing.pdf

description: Other Transactional Authority Request for White PapersModular Power Generation and Distribution: The Department of Defense has an urgent, unmet requirement for relocatable Modular Power Generation and Distribution solutions. A solution is required at various locations across the 50 United States. Current operational sites lack the foundational power generation and distribution architecture necessary to support modern, power-intensive mission equipment. There is a critical need for these solutions to be implemented no later than 28 February 2028 to meet additional mission objectives. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Huntsville Center (CEHNC) has an ongoing mission to support requirements across the Department of War (DoW). CEHNC has been tasked to provide all manufacturing, procurement, shipping, delivery, installation, and testing of Modular Power Generation and Distribution Solutions for 10-12 sites in the 50 United States.

title: LD5 Anchor Bar Refurbishment
description: This procurement is for the refurbishment of eight (8) used Government owned anchor bars assemblies recently removed from Lock and Dam 9. The anchor bar assemblies range in age from 30-90 years old, are in poor physical condition, and feature seized components due to a historic lack of articulation and lubrication. description: SUBJECT: AOI 3 Space Intelligence � Third Call for Submissions Under the Notice ID FA8806-26-S-0001 (01 July 2026) Kronos Family of Systems (FoS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) 1. Purpose: This document constitutes the Third Call under the Kronos FoS CSO. Refer to the Kronos FoS CSO 2.0 for all administrative, legal, and overarching procedures. 2. This Call specifically requests Phase 1A (Quad Chart and White Paper) submissions to address Area of Interest (AOI) 3, and its Focus Area Statements (FAS) detailed below. 3. FAS #1 (AOI 03-FAS01): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks an enterprise collection management orchestration capability to coherently link existing sensor optimization and scheduling capabilities for sensing of the space domain. The capability focuses on the optimal use of finite sensors to meet collection requirements that fulfill positional tracking, operational intelligence, and foundational intelligence needs. This effort will focus not only on USSF sensors but also establish interfaces with other DoW, Intelligence Community (IC), allied, and commercial assets. A successful orchestration �brain� must demonstrate the ability to integrate multiple orchestration engines utilizing distinct scheduling paradigms (e.g., pre-planned, dynamic tip-and-cue event response, automated metric optimization), rapidly adjudicate scheduling conflicts when dynamic tasks out-prioritize deliberate needs, and disseminate commander decisions to sensors, sensor brokers, and external orchestration platforms. The capability shall consider weather, planned and unplanned outages, multiple sensor phenomenologies, tasking acknowledgment response times, PED and correlation timelines, competing prioritization schemes, and the ability to monitor execution during dynamic events. Furthermore, the proposed solution must deliver intuitive user feedback regarding collection requirement satisfaction (with full traceability), candidate rescheduling options for human review, human-in-the-loop intervention, and transparent performance metrics. A successful solution shall provide a rapid path for a prototype to host on Secret and Top Secret domains to interface with existing tasking engines and sensors. 4. FAS #2 (AOI 03-FAS02): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks innovative commercial solutions and products addressing the ability to ingest and analyze radar and sensor data for characterization of on-orbit assets. Capability should allow support analysis of radar cross sections, object discrimination and velocity and maneuver determination. 5. FAS #3 (AOI 03-FAS03): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks innovative commercial solutions and products addressing novel or innovative ways to ingest and analyze commercial RF data and distribution of data to operations centers to support object maneuver detection, status assessments, and object identification efforts. 6. FAS #4 (AOI 03-FAS04): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks innovative commercial solutions and products addressing deployment of capabilities to the tactical edge, using novel or innovative methodologies to transport data back to operations centers. Solutions should demonstrate the ability to operate through disconnected connectivity and demonstrate re-sync of data once re-connected. 7. FAS #5 (AOI 3-FAS05): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program and its stakeholders seek innovative commercial solutions and products which enable immediate reporting of space events to the U.S. Space Command Joint Operations Center. This capability will collate all event knowledge as it�s occurring to provide Combatant Commanders, Joint Staff, and National Leadership situational awareness, real-time updates, and response options for approval. The system must be able to support both coalition space event conferences and U.S. -only space event conferences. 8. Offerors may submit more than one white paper and quad chart for this call and any future call. The white paper and quad chart proposed prototype solution may address one or more focus areas; but it must be clear in the proposed solution how the proposed prototype addresses the AOI and which focus areas. 9. Submission Timeline: Questions regarding this Call shall be submitted no later than 1200 Pacific Time on 09 September 2026. Phase 1A submissions (Quad Chart and White Paper) shall be received no later than 1700 Pacific Time on 25 September 2026. 10. Additional Information: All submission instructions, eligibility requirements, evaluation procedures, and applicable terms and conditions are contained within the Kronos FoS CSO. description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) Containerized Payload Capabilities 1. PURPOSE The Department of the Navy (DON), Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager for Robotic and Autonomous Systems (DRPM RAS), is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to conduct market research regarding containerized payload capabilities. The purpose of this RFI is to: Identify the realm of the possible for containerized payload capabilities that will provide operational utility to the Fleet; and Characterize the physical, electrical, data, communications, thermal, and other interfaces required by those capabilities to inform future approaches for simplifying payload integration across Naval afloat / ashore enterprise. The Government is intentionally not prescribing specific payload capabilities or detailed performance requirements through this RFI. DRPM RAS seeks industry�s perspective on what is possible, including capabilities the Government may not currently be considering. The Government is interested in existing products, adaptations of existing technologies, and technically feasible concepts that could be demonstrated, produced affordably, and delivered at scale on an accelerated timeline. Information obtained through this RFI will inform Fleet engagement, budgeting, experimentation, demonstrations, prize challenges, prototyping efforts, follow-on market research, requirements development, and potential future acquisition activities. 2. BACKGROUND Robotic and autonomous systems have the potential to increase the reach, persistence, capacity, and distribution of naval capabilities while reducing risk to personnel and high-value platforms. The Department of the Navy is pursuing opportunities to accelerate the development, integration, acquisition, and fielding of RAS capabilities responsive to Fleet operational needs. A key opportunity is the ability to rapidly add, exchange, and scale mission capabilities without requiring each payload to be designed around a single purpose-built platform. Containerized payloads may provide a means to separate mission capability from the underlying host platform, enabling the DON to more rapidly integrate new technologies, interchange capabilities among suitable platforms, and increase operational capacity through distributed employment at scale. DRPM RAS is therefore seeking industry�s perspective on the breadth of capabilities that could be delivered in a containerized form factor. The Government seeks to understand not only what is commercially or operationally available today, but also what could reasonably be adapted, developed, or demonstrated on an accelerated timeline. The Government also seeks to better understand the host-platform interfaces and services required to support a broad range of containerized capabilities. Understanding common requirements for power, data, communications, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, and other services�as well as existing commercial, maritime, and military interface standards�may enable the Government to simplify future integration and reduce platform-specific engineering. DRPM RAS intends to use the information received to develop a broad portfolio of potential capabilities for consideration by Fleet stakeholders. Fleet interest may subsequently inform more focused technical exchanges, RFIs, demonstrations, prototyping activities, requirements development, and acquisition efforts. Of particular interest are capabilities that can be produced affordably and at scale on an accelerated timeline, with the objective of enabling delivery of meaningful quantities. 3. DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS / GUARDRAILS The Government is particularly interested in containerized payload concepts that, to the greatest extent practicable: Utilize a standard 20-foot and/or 40-foot ISO container form factor; Are platform agnostic, minimizing platform-specific integration and enabling employment from multiple suitable host platforms; Support remote operation and Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA)/open interfaces, as applicable; Are capable of being produced affordably and employed at scale; and Are available today or could reasonably be demonstrated, produced, and delivered on an accelerated timeline. These characteristics are intended to guide, rather than unnecessarily constrain, industry responses. Respondents should not exclude a potentially valuable capability solely because it does not meet every desired characteristic. Significant deviations, limitations, or host-platform dependencies should instead be identified in the response. The maritime operating environment (afloat and ashore) should be considered the baseline for proposed concepts and interfaces. 4. INFORMATION REQUESTED Respondents are invited to identify one or more containerized payload capability concepts that could provide operational value to the Fleet. The Government encourages respondents to submit multiple concepts and prioritizes breadth of relevant ideas over detailed engineering descriptions at this stage. For each capability concept, provide the following information: 4.1 Capability / Operational Effect Briefly describe: The proposed capability; The operational effect or mission function it enables; and How the capability could provide value when employed from a robotic, autonomous, or other maritime platform or shore site. Respondents are specifically encouraged to identify capabilities that the Government may not currently be considering. Concepts are not limited to currently fielded products. Respondents may identify existing capabilities, adaptations of existing technologies, developmental capabilities, or technically feasible concepts that could reasonably be matured within the Government�s desired timeframe. 4.2 Host-Platform Interfaces / Umbilicals Identify the interfaces and services required from the host platform to operate the proposed capability. As applicable, provide: Electrical power: AC/DC, voltage, phase/frequency, continuous and peak power requirements; Data: required interfaces/protocols, approximate bandwidth, and physical medium such as copper or fiber; Communications/RF: external antenna, RF, SATCOM, PNT/GPS, or other connectivity requirements; Thermal management: ventilation, cooling, chilled water, or other heat-rejection requirements; Mechanical/physical interfaces: mounting or other significant physical integration requirements; Grounding and bonding requirements; Other services: fuel, fluids, compressed air, seawater, drainage, exhaust, or other external services, as applicable; and Any additional connection or equipment external to the container required for operation of the capability. Where applicable, identify existing commercial, maritime, military, or other industry-standard connectors, interfaces, protocols, or specifications currently used or recommended for these connections. Respondents are encouraged to identify interface approaches that minimize host-platform modification and facilitate rapid installation, removal, replacement, and interchange of containerized payloads in a maritime environment. 4.3 Maturity / Availability Identify whether the capability: Is available or demonstrable today; Requires adaptation or integration of existing technology; or Requires additional development. Provide the earliest date at which a representative capability could be demonstrated and, if different, the earliest date at which production units could reasonably begin delivery. description: This award announcement is for the North Jetty Major Maintenance � Phase II, Klickitat County, Washington. The MCR federal navigation project is situated at the border between Washington and Oregon, where the Columbia River meets the Pacific Ocean. Deep-draft navigation through the MCR is facilitated by three primary navigation structures-North Jetty, South Jetty, and Jetty A-with a combined authorized length of 10.2 miles. The North Jetty has an authorized length of 2.5 miles extending to Station 130+00; however, it has not been constructed to its full authorized length. The initial construction of the North Jetty concluded at approximately Station 122+00, resulting in a constructed length of approximately 2.3 miles. This jetty was the second of the three to be constructed and was completed in 1917. Subsequent repairs and rehabilitations along various sections of the North Jetty were carried out in 1939, 1965, 2005, 2015, and 2019. Both initial construction and repairs utilized stone with a minimum density ranging from 167 to 180 pounds per cubic foot (pd). The side slopes of the jetty vary between 1:1.25 and 1:2 (vertical: horizontal), with an average crest elevation of 25 ft msl. Since construction, a total of 3,569,030 tons of armor stone have been placed. The Mouth of the Columbia River (MCR) North Jetty is located at the southwest corner of Washington State near Ilwaco, WA. Access to the north jetty is from N Head Rd and Cape Disappointment State Park. Mandatory work for MCR North Jetty Expedited Repairs includes toe, side slope, and crest repair construction above -5 feet NAVD88 elevation along approximately 900 feet of the jetty trunk primarily on the ocean side. These sections will be repaired and reconstructed to a design crest width of 30 feet, side slopes of 1V:2H and a crest elevation of +24.5 feet NAVD88. The estimated stone volume required for the repairs is approximately 11,100 cubic yards with an approximate minimum stone densities of 185 pounds per cubic foot. Expected stone size is between 20-40 tons each. A jetty crest haul road on top of the jetty must be constructed and staging area developed to store the large quantity of jetty armor stone.
